title: Biometry-Clip interchange 1.4
description: Portable case or patient-library document. Version 1.4 adds an optional compact biometry-parser report snapshot. Versions 1.0–1.3 keep their original vocabularies. Runtime validation also checks numeric measurements and report field states.
